ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AD$ is the altitude on side $BC$, and $CE$ is an angle bisector that intersects with $AD$ at point $P$. Given that $\angle APE=55^\circ$ and $\angle AEP=80^\circ$, find the measure of $\angle BAC$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AD\perp BC$,\\
it follows that $\angle PDC=90^\circ$,\\
Given $\angle CPD=\angle APE=55^\circ$,\\
it implies $\angle PCD=90^\circ-55^\circ=35^\circ$,\\
Since $CE$ is an angle bisector,\\
it follows $\angle ACE=\angle PCD=35^\circ$,\\
Hence, $\angle BAC=180^\circ-35^\circ-80^\circ=\boxed{65^\circ}$.
